base.rule: The full frozen canonical 100 is published in data/patterns.json; no planned canonical entries remain.

policy.name_freeze: IDs and JA/EN display names are frozen for production unless source verification proves a factual error.
policy.scope_rule: Broad techniques, textile traditions, styles, weave/effect terms, and material-inspired visual families remain qualified rather than being presented as one universal fixed motif.
policy.publication_rule: Canonical 100 publication is complete. Any future growth requires a new explicitly versioned expansion plan rather than silently extending this frozen set.
